entries.text: CedarDB tuning files now apply hash partitioning, and the adapter claims `PARTITIONING`. CedarDB supports only `PARTITION BY HASH` and creates its partitions itself, so every partitioning column is hashed and no explicit partitions are emitted; a primary key need not include the partition columns. Each request is verified from `pg_get_partkeydef`. Clustering and sorting are rejected when the tuning file loads, because CedarDB does not implement `CLUSTER`. A TPC-H profile is at `examples/tunings/cedardb/tpch_tuned.yaml`.
